info.name: Saheli Backend — Auth, Profile & Family
info.description:
Authentication (phone + OTP) and Profile CRUD for the Saheli Spring Boot backend.

**Flow to run in order (Auth folder):**
1. Register User — creates an unverified User row and issues an OTP
2. Verify OTP (Register) — verifies the OTP, marks the user verified, returns access + refresh JWT
3. Login User — for an already-verified phone, issues a fresh OTP
4. Verify OTP (Login) — same endpoint as verify, returns fresh tokens
5. Refresh Token — exchanges a refresh token for a new access + refresh pair

All tokens/ids are captured automatically into collection variables by each request's Tests script, so requests can be run top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner.

**Profile folder** requires `accessToken` to be set (run the Auth flow first). Auth is inherited at the collection level as a Bearer token using `{{accessToken}}`; the four Auth requests explicitly opt out of it since `/api/auth/**` is public.

OTP demo mode is on by default in local dev (`OTP_DEMO_MODE=true`) — every OTP is `123456` and is echoed back in the response as `devOtp`, which the Register/Login requests capture into `{{otp}}` automatically.

**Family folder** requires `accessToken` to be set (run the Auth flow first) and covers create/list/get, invite-consent membership, role updates, and member/managed-member removal (`/api/families/**`). Some requests (List My Pending Invites, Accept Invite, Decline Invite) must run as the *invited* user rather than the inviter — they override auth with the `invitedUserAccessToken` collection variable; run the Auth flow a second time for `invitedPhone` to populate it.

request.description: Creates a new (unverified) User row for `phone` if one doesn't already exist, then issues an OTP with purpose REGISTER. Fails if the phone is already a **verified** user. Public endpoint — no token required.

request.description: Issues an OTP with purpose LOGIN for an already-**verified** phone. Fails if the phone has never completed registration. Public endpoint — no token required.

request.description:
Verifies the most recent unconsumed OTP for `phone` (works for both REGISTER and LOGIN purposes). On success, marks the user verified (if this was a REGISTER OTP), updates `lastLoginAt`, and returns a fresh access + refresh JWT pair. Public endpoint — no token required.

Run **Register User** or **Login User** first so `{{otp}}` is populated (auto-captured from `devOtp` in demo mode).

item.name: Profile

formdata.description: JSON body for ProfileRequestDto — must be sent as a part named 'profileRequest' with Content-Type application/json.
The profile photo file (uploaded to S3; only the object key is stored).

request.description:
One-time onboarding: creates the `UserProfile` row for the authenticated user (updates `name`/`email` on `User`, uploads `profilePhoto` to S3 if provided, sets `isCompleted=true`). Requires a `USER`-typed Bearer access token. Success response is the plain string `Profile Saved Successfully` (no longer echoes the user id, as of commit `5d863d5`).

Multipart request — `profileRequest` must be attached as a **text part with Content-Type: application/json** (not a query param, not top-level JSON body), and `profilePhoto` as a **file part**. In Postman, select a file for the `profilePhoto` key before sending.

**`preferredLanguage` note (known gap, not yet fixed in code):** `ProfileRequestDto.preferredLanguage` was annotated `@NotBlank` in commit `5d863d5`, but the controller's `@RequestPart("profileRequest") ProfileRequestDto profileRequest` parameter has no `@Valid`/`@Validated` — Spring does not run bean validation on a `@RequestPart` without it, so this constraint is currently a no-op. Omitting `preferredLanguage` does **not** return a clean 400; it either fails as a 500 (null hits the `preferred_language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL` column) or silently persists an empty string, depending on whether the JSON key is missing vs. sent as `""`. See the two error examples below.

response.name: 403 Forbidden — missing or invalid access token
500 Internal Server Error — unexpected failure (e.g. S3 upload)
500 Internal Server Error — preferredLanguage omitted (known gap, see request description)

request.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile. `avatarUrl` is a freshly generated S3 pre-signed URL (10-minute expiry), not the raw stored object key — `null` if no photo was ever uploaded. Requires a `USER`-typed Bearer access token.

response.name: 403 Forbidden — missing or invalid access token
500 Internal Server Error — profile not created yet

formdata.description: New photo file. Uploaded to S3 first; DB is updated; the previous S3 object is deleted only after a successful DB update.

request.description: Replaces the authenticated user's profile photo. Requires an existing `UserProfile` (run Create Profile first) and a `USER`-typed Bearer access token.

response.name: 404 Not Found — profile does not exist yet
403 Forbidden — missing or invalid access token

request.description: Partially updates `email` (on `User`) and `city`/`preferredLanguage` (on `UserProfile`) for the authenticated user. `email: null` leaves the existing email unchanged; `city`/`preferredLanguage` are overwritten with whatever is sent (including `null`). Requires an existing `UserProfile` and a `USER`-typed Bearer access token.

item.name: Expense Groups & Multi-Currency Splitting
item.description:
SRS Module 11 (§11 'Multi-Currency Expense Groups') & REST endpoints for /api/expense-groups and /api/expenses.

Capabilities:
- Group lifecycle: Create, List, Get, Update, Soft-Delete
- Group Membership: Add, Remove (requires settled 0.00 balance)
- Dynamic bill splitting: EQUAL, PERCENTAGE, SHARES with 1-paise rounding
- Multi-currency normalization (INR, USD, EUR, AED, GBP)
- Debt settlement tracking (UPI, Cash, Bank Transfer)
- Pairwise debt minimization algorithm & group sync (/sync)
- Rolling 30-day spend rollup for Dashboard tile (/api/expenses/summary/30-day)
